name: indestructible type*
summary: Independent foundry by Owen Earl making free typefaces such as Jost*, plus pay-what-you-want variable versions.
description: indestructible type* is a one-person type foundry making free, versatile, archetypal typefaces named after designers of the past: Jost*, Bodoni*, Besley*, Cooper*, Marauder, Cowboy, Gnomon, No Tears and Drafting. Font pages offer live editable specimens, weights, character set and language support; static styles are free and variable versions are pay-what-you-want from $10, with free webfont hosting for Jost*.
